load_mape_metric: load the mape metric module using evaluate.load with the mape identifier
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the mape metric evaluation interface
compute_mape_score: compute the mean absolute percentage error from predictions and references arrays
create_mape_metric_multilist: create a mape metric instance using the multilist config for multi-dimensional predictions
test_mape_compute_raw_values: test the mape metric compute method with multioutput set to raw_values for per-output errors
